add_rc_deps(runonce.rc ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/res/icon.ico)

# runonce.exe is all Rust (runonce-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/runonce-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# runonce.c  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/runonce-rust/src/runonce/runonce.rs)
# The resources are the one thing cmake still compiles, in this OBJECT library
# whose windres command the cargo link replays.
add_library(runonce_res OBJECT runonce.rc)
target_compile_definitions(runonce_res PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
target_include_directories(runonce_res PRIVATE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
add_cargo_module(runonce runonce-cargo runonce.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE runonce-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS runonce_res)
